sentences.en: All the members of the committee consented to my proposal.
sentences.zh: 委员会的所有成员都同意了我的提议。

sentences.en: A discussion of the proposal seems to be in order.
sentences.zh: 讨论这个建议似乎很有必要。

sentences.en: I'm not going to agree to your proposal so readily.
sentences.zh: 我不会轻易答应你的提议。

senses.zh: 提议，建议；提案；（计划、建议等的）提出；求婚
